描述_ZN: Fan Page of Cotton Painting, Qing Dynasty, painted by Yu Province, on paper with color, 16.7 cm in length and 51.4 cm in width.　　The fan page is self-titled: "Yu Province of Luting on the autumn day of the first month of the year." Inscription: "Zeng San's" seal in vermilion.　　The year "Jiawu" is the fifty-third year of the Kangxi Emperor (1714), when Yu was 23 years old.　　In the center of the painting is a cotton branch with flowers and leaves. Cotton as a cash crop, flowers are not fragrant, color is not bright, has not been classified as the subject of flower and bird painting, therefore, the fan side of the frame Huixiao with the title "this fan to write cotton is also strange ancient." This picture is drawn with a fine brushwork, the color scheme is light and fresh, but unfortunately the white in the flowers return to lead, turning black and yellow, which subtracts a lot of color from the painting. On the left side, there is a seven-word poem "Bai Shi Weng" recorded by Yang Jin, a famous local painter who was 71 years old at the time, which not only balances the sparse relationship between the left and right of the fan, but also adds more cultural flavor to the painting as well as the friendship of fellow countrymen outside the painting.
